sentences.en: "Liberty, equality, fraternity" is also the national motto of Haiti.
sentences.zh: 自由、平等、博爱也是海地的国歌。

sentences.en: I’ve made advancing gender equality a foreign policy priority.
sentences.zh: 我已经把推进性别平等作为外交政策的重点。

sentences.en: When you’re accustomed to privilege, equality feels like oppression.
sentences.zh: 当你习惯了特权，平等的感觉就像压迫一样。

senses.zh: 同等；平等；相等；等式；等同性
